title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.0 (Peaked October 24, 2026 at 06:44 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 367 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The Sun will eventually swell into a red giant, likely engulfing Mercury and Venus — and possibly Earth. 🌞💫

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
